Tom / Aisha —

Thanks for the call today. Below are concise notes and agreed action items. Please tell me if I missed anything.

Summary:
- Goal: complete SIG + CAIQ mapping and provide SOC-related evidence to support SkyFusion's internal review (not a formal SOC attestation request).
- Scope: production hosted API usage (hosted + dedicated for now); PHI flows are in-scope only for requests routed through your dedicated instance.
- Owners on call: Grace (Redwood contact / intake lead), Marissa (Customer Success — billing/SLA questions), Ben (technical owner for logs / artifacts), Tom (SkyFusion security), Aisha (SkyFusion compliance).

Agreed action items (owner — target):
1) Redwood: provide CAIQ mapping draft (initial mapping file) — Grace / Marissa — target 2026-11-20 EOD.
2) Redwood: deliver sample log extracts and anonymization checklist — Ben — target 2026-11-19 EOD. (Ben notes extracts will be hashed/anonymized by default.)
3) SkyFusion: mark priority control IDs in the attached SIG worksheet and return with flags for "Immediate" vs "Deferred" — Tom / Aisha — target 2026-11-18 EOD.
4) Redwood + SkyFusion: follow-up 30m sync to review CAIQ mapping and sample artifacts if needed — tentative 2026-11-22 11:00 PT (Grace to send invite once mapping is shared).

Attachments & links:
- Attached: redwood_precall_checklist.pdf (call checklist)
- Redwood will upload artifacts to shared folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/SF-3581/SIG-evidence
- SkyFusion questionnaire: SkyFusion_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (from your initial email)

Notes/context: Ben confirmed we will provide extracts only (no raw PHI), and that the anonymization approach will be documented. Marissa noted any billing or SLA questions should be tabled until the evidence review is complete.

If all good, we'll proceed on the action item deadlines above.

Thanks again — speak soon.

Best,
